issues.description: The solution implementation defines toString() with return type Object (public Object toString()) which does not match the expected String return type described in the problem statement and example. This causes a compile/override error (@Override will fail) and prevents the solution from matching the intended behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString() method signature in the solution to return String: replace 'public Object toString()' with 'public String toString()' and ensure the method returns a String. This aligns the implementation with the problem description and allows @Override to succeed.
